Genes that lost many of their sgRNAs

Source: R/qc.R
qc_genes_with_lost_guides.Rd

Lists genes where at least a given fraction of sgRNAs were not detected at a stage. Hits for such genes rest on few sgRNAs and should be interpreted with care.

Usage

qc_genes_with_lost_guides(rep_data, stage, min_frac = 0.4)

Arguments

rep_data

Output of qc_guide_representation.

stage

Name of the stage (one of the names of stages given to qc_guide_representation).

min_frac

Minimum fraction of lost sgRNAs (default is 0.4, e.g. 2 of 5).

Value

A tibble from rep_data$gene_summary, one row per gene, sorted by fraction and number of lost sgRNAs.

Examples

rep_data <- qc_guide_representation(
  exampleCounts,
  stages = list(Plasmid = "Plasmid", T0 = c("T0_1", "T0_2", "T0_3")))
qc_genes_with_lost_guides(rep_data, stage = "T0")
#> # A tibble: 5 × 6
#>   stage Gene  n_guides n_detected n_lost frac_lost
#>   <fct> <chr>    <int>      <int>  <int>     <dbl>
#> 1 T0    AKAP1        5          3      2       0.4
#> 2 T0    EDNRB        5          3      2       0.4
#> 3 T0    FTSJ3        5          3      2       0.4
#> 4 T0    MDM4         5          3      2       0.4
#> 5 T0    MERTK        5          3      2       0.4
